# Release ship (dockyrd binaries)

Self-update and `scripts/install.sh` download assets from **GitHub Releases** on `Joeydekruis/dockyrd`. CI builds them with **GoReleaser** when a **`v*`** tag is pushed.

Rule summary: [release-ship.mdc](../../../.cursor/rules/release-ship.mdc).  
Merge gates: [push-to-main](../../../.cursor/skills/push-to-main/SKILL.md).

## 1. Preconditions

- [ ] Joey asked for a release (not only merge to `main`).
- [ ] `package.json` version = newest dated `CHANGELOG.md` section.
- [ ] `development` pushed; `main` merged and pushed (push-to-main complete).
- [ ] Local **`make build`** green (same web export GoReleaser runs in `.goreleaser.yaml` `before.hooks`).

## 2. Tag (triggers CI)

From repo root on **`main`** (or tag pointing at the merge commit on `main`):

```bash
VERSION=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")
git fetch origin main
git checkout main
git pull origin main
git tag "v${VERSION}"
git push origin "v${VERSION}"
git checkout development
```

Use **`v${VERSION}`** only — asset names use **`${VERSION}` without `v`** (GoReleaser `.Version`).

## 3. Wait for Release workflow

Workflow: `.github/workflows/release.yml` → `goreleaser release --clean`.

```bash
gh run list --repo Joeydekruis/dockyrd --workflow release.yml --limit 1
gh run watch --repo Joeydekruis/dockyrd <run-id>
```

**Stop** if the run fails. Read `--log-failed` (common: `pnpm --dir web build` / static export errors). Fix on `development`, bump **next patch**, re-merge, **new tag** — never reuse a failed tag.

## 4. Verify release assets (mandatory)

```bash
VERSION=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")
gh release view "v${VERSION}" --repo Joeydekruis/dockyrd --json assets,tagName \
  --jq '{tag: .tagName, assets: [.assets[].name]}'
```

Required for panel self-update (`internal/updater/github.go`):

| Asset |
|-------|
| `dockyrd_${VERSION}_linux_amd64.tar.gz` |
| `dockyrd_${VERSION}_linux_arm64.tar.gz` |
| `checksums.txt` |

Optional cosign artefacts: `checksums.txt.sig`, `checksums.txt.pem`.

If **`/releases/latest`** is this tag but a tarball is missing, Updates in the panel shows **`no release asset matching dockyrd_${VERSION}_linux_${arch}`** — wait for CI or fix the broken release; do not ask users to retry update until step 4 passes.

## 5. Optional release notes

If the tag was pushed without a GitHub Release body:

```bash
gh release edit "v${VERSION}" --repo Joeydekruis/dockyrd --notes-file - <<'EOF'
See CHANGELOG.md for this version.
EOF
```

Prefer notes copied from the `CHANGELOG.md` section for that version.

## 6. Report to Joey

- Tag: `vX.Y.Z`
- Release URL: `https://github.com/Joeydekruis/dockyrd/releases/tag/vX.Y.Z`
- Release workflow: link + **success**
- Asset checklist: both linux tarballs + checksums.txt present
- Reminder: arm64 servers need **`linux_arm64`** asset (not amd64)

## Recovery after failed release

1. Inspect `gh run view <id> --log-failed`.
2. Maintainer may delete the broken GitHub Release and tag if nothing good shipped.
3. Patch bump (`0.0.36` → `0.0.37`), changelog, commit, push `development`, merge `main`, push **`v0.0.37`**.
4. Re-run verification from section 4.
